scope: one fresh Win32 fixture; recorded public observe/dispatch/results/observe/close; one focus+A+release_all action; independent fixture score; no retry; 2 s late-input horizon
stop_rules: Require exactly one fresh fixture window and exact foreground PID/HWND/title before the public caller.
Validate public observation no-authority/no-input and artifact/source/image hashes before dispatch.
Do not dispatch on failed before observation or generation mismatch.
One dispatch only. If unresolved, cancel once, preserve UNKNOWN, and never replay.
Retain exact result lookup, both observations, score, release/horizon, and cleanup before closing the exact fixture.
